_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d6; applied 5 Oct 2026), from Blueprint D2 (relationship + why) and Part I (caption + reaction). A thread appears as soon as both endpoint deductions are confirmed (A20).

threads.why: The bell's resonance matches the Echo Lantern's network behaviour.
threads.caption: The bell resonance matches the machine's documented network behavior.

reaction.speaker: leela
reaction.line: Then the bell was part of the machine.

threads.why: The fixed 2:17 clocks conflict with Arun's 2:31 watch.
threads.caption: The 2:17 freeze conflicts with Arun's 2:31 watch.

threads.why: The apprentice at Nia's door is the walker who carried her.
threads.caption: The same staff crosses the river.

threads.why: The sluice feeds the lantern chamber. The river fed the overload.
threads.caption: The hidden sluice ends beneath the lantern chamber.

reaction.speaker: leela
reaction.line: The lantern drank the river to keep burning.

threads.why: The walker has no face because the purge took it.
threads.caption: The faceless walker is the purge's work.

reaction.speaker: leela
reaction.line: He took himself out of every memory of her.

threads.why: The purge explains the name scraped from Mira's register.
threads.caption: The deleted apprentice entry explains the missing identity.

reaction.speaker: mira
reaction.line: The name was removed, not forgotten.
